name: PhotoToolFinder

sources.title: Homepage — curated directory of online photo editing tools (357 tools, 38 categories)
Suggest a tool — full submission form; free review (months) or priority review within 7 days

conditions: Free review exists but 'can take up to a few months'; priority review completes within 7 days and is paid (refunded if rejected)
All listings go through human review — paying only speeds up the queue
requirements: Photo editing niche only: tool must edit/change/compress/convert images — 'can the user upload an image?' is the litmus test
Must have at least one web version — 'Web' is a mandatory platform checkbox
No pure generators and no video-first tools
Single-model AI frontends rejected unless they expose multiple models
Website claims must be true — 'not obviously false'
preparation: Tool name and URL of the web version
Best-fit category from the 38 listed (e.g. AI-First Photo Editors, Background Removers)
Overview, min 300 characters, plain prose only — no HTML or links
At least 3 key features as short phrases
Pricing model (Free/Freemium/Paid), learning curve, platforms, alternatives already in the index, contact email
workflow: Open https://phototoolfinder.com/submit ('Suggest a Tool' in nav)
Choose Free review or paid Priority review (7 days, refunded on rejection)
Fill Basics, What it does, and Details sections; add alternatives from existing listings
Tick the human-review acknowledgement and click 'Submit tool'
Listing appears under the chosen category after independent research by the editor
watchFor: Strict niche — only photo/image editing tools; a general SaaS product will be declined
Reviewers may rewrite/edit submitted copy during independent research
Free queue can take months — only the priority tier has a defined SLA
IP address is stored with the submission
A stale priority-submission session may linger ('You started a priority submission…') — 'Start a new submission' resets it
countsAsLive: The tool appears on phototoolfinder.com inside its chosen category with a Details page
unknowns: Priority review price — the payment amount was not shown on the rendered page
Whether the free review guarantees eventual inclusion or can silently lapse
Notification flow beyond the contact email
